messages.text: Map the chain from a Wireless Communication market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer.

建議主軸：Use the market/use-case requirement to select the measurable RF/protocol/channel parameter, then require a Signal Generator for standard-compliant stimulus/channel emulation and a Signal Analyzer for frequency/bandwidth/EVM/spectrum analysis; for FWA, the source directly lists VSG/VSA, R&S SMW200A, R&S FSW, R&S CMP180/CMP200 among relevant instruments [1][54].
### 推薦先賣
知識庫未證實單一「最優先」產品；可直接對接的已證實方向是：FWA UE RF parametric / regulatory / coexistence testing uses indicators such as output power, EVM, OBW, receiver sensitivity BLER, emission mask, spurious emissions and WLAN coexistence, and the cited instrument examples include VSA, VSG, R&S FSW, R&S SMW200A and R&S CMP180/CMP200 [1][54]. NTN E2E testing directly maps to SMW200A channel emulation parameters such as delay, Doppler and pathloss, while FSW is identified for component testing / SAN transmitter measurement [8][9][10][11].
### 產品與 Option 對接表
| 產品線 | 可接軌的需求 | 知識庫確認的 option / 規格 | 為什麼適合 | 證據 | 缺口 / 報價風險 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S SMW200A Signal Generator / Channel Emulator | FWA RF parametric receiver stimulus; NTN E2E satellite RF link emulation | Frequency up to 67 GHz, RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz and up to 4 GHz with R&S SMW-K555; signal generation software includes LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18, OFDM and custom digital modulation [11]. For NTN E2E, SMW firmware ≥ 5.30 with K820 supports customized dynamic fading, satellite trajectory modeling, longer path delays, enhanced Doppler, up to 1073 ms delay and up to ±1 MHz Doppler [8]. | FWA test sources list VSG and R&S SMW200A as instruments, while NTN sources identify SMW200A as the core signal generator / channel emulator [1][9][10][54]. | [1][8][9][10][11][54] | FWA taxonomy does not provide test cases, limits, configurations or pass/fail criteria [2]. NTN recommended configurations are presentation recommendations, not a formal configuration guide or quotation BOM [14]. |
| R&S FSW Signal / Spectrum Analyzer | FWA RF parametric and regulatory TX analysis; NTN component testing / SAN transmitter measurement | Frequency up to 85 GHz with overrange to 90 GHz; analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz; signal analysis software includes LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18, OFDM signal analysis and vector signal analysis [11]. | FWA test sources list VSA and R&S FSW among instruments; NTN sources identify FSW for component testing and SAN transmitter measurement [1][9][10][11][54]. | [1][9][10][11][54] | Formal frequency/bandwidth/options should still be checked in formal product specifications, because the NTN source is a presentation summary [11][13]. |
| R&S CMP180 RF generator/analyzer communication tester | FWA production / wireless device multiport RF testing; WLAN coexistence-related Wi‑Fi signaling and NR FR1 measurements | CMP180 is a Radio Communication Tester configurable with multiport RF generator/analyzer, communication-standard measurement options, waveform options and R&S VSE analysis [16][17]. It supports simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing and RF generator/analyzer no. 1 plus optional no. 2, each with 8 SnapN ports [17][24]. IF bandwidth is 250 MHz, or 500 MHz with R&S CMP-K185 [21][27]. NR FR1 analyzer option R&S CMP-KM600 has EVM < 0.5% under the cited 100 MHz / SCS 30 kHz / 16QAM condition [22][28]. | FWA sources list CMP180/CMP200 among instruments, and FWA coexistence requires WLAN coexistence testing with Wi‑Fi signaling [1][54]. CMP180 has WLAN and NR measurement options listed in the knowledge base [22][23][28][29]. | [1][16][17][21][22][23][24][27][28][29][54] | CMP180 is a radio communication tester, not a standalone general-purpose VSG/VSA; the sources do not give a complete FWA configuration or quotation BOM [16][17][58]. |
| R&S CMX500 communication tester with vector signal analysis / ARB generator | FWA functional / signaling-style testing where E2E throughput, NSA/SA attach, latency and CA/ENDC/DC combinations are required | CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, RF parametric testing, fading propagation conditions and multiple OBT hardware configurations [47]. R&S CMX-B500A provides IF vector signal analysis and ARB generator functionality, and R&S CMX-B600B provides FR1 vector signal analysis and ARB generator functionality [41][42]. NR FR1 measurements support channel bandwidth 3 MHz to 100 MHz, and the CMX-KM600 analyzer EVM condition is <0.5% at 100 MHz under the cited condition; CMX-KW601 generator EVM is <0.5% at 100 MHz under the cited condition [43]. | FWA functional indicators include E2E max throughput, NSA/SA attach, latency and CA/ENDC/DC combinations, while the FWA roadmap source lists CMX500 among tool categories/instruments [54]. | [41][42][43][47][54] | This row is not pure “Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer”; it is a signaling/network-emulation tester with generator/analyzer functions [41][42][47]. |
### 場景切入建議
| 場景 | 推薦組合 | 切入重點 | 未驗證事項 |
|---|---|---|---|
| FWA UE RF parametric / operator-required RF TRX checks | SMW200A + FSW, or CMP180 where multiport production-style RF generator/analyzer is needed | Market/use-case side: FWA opportunities include DSL replacement, work/schooling from home, government broadband plans, connecting the unconnected and 5G launch [6]. Measurement side: RF parametric indicators include NR 3GPP RF TRx specification, output power, EVM, OBW, receiver sensitivity BLER, band permutations and CAs, and are mostly required by operators [1][54]. Capability side: SMW200A provides NR signal generation and wide frequency/modulation bandwidth, while FSW provides high-frequency, wideband NR signal analysis [11]. | Exact FWA test cases, limits, configurations and pass/fail criteria are not provided [2]. |
| FWA regulatory testing | FSW / signal-spectrum analysis path; SG only if the customer test setup requires a stimulus source | Regulatory indicators include RF output power, emission mask and spurious emissions, with the goal of CE/FCC certification [1][54]. FSW provides signal/spectrum analysis capability with frequency up to 85 GHz, overrange to 90 GHz and analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz [11]. | The passages do not provide country-specific regulatory test cases, limits or a full instrument configuration [2][58]. |
| FWA coexistence with Wi‑Fi | CMP180 RF generator/analyzer with WLAN measurement/generator options, plus broader VSG/VSA where needed | FWA coexistence testing is defined as WLAN coexistence testing with Wi‑Fi signaling to ensure no impact between different radios [1][54]. CMP180 supports communication-standard measurement options and RF generator/analyzer architecture [16][17], and its listed options include WLAN IEEE 802.11ax/be analyzer/generator capabilities [22][23][28][29]. | The knowledge base does not provide a full coexistence test plan, chamber/fixture setup, or pass/fail limits [58]. |
| NTN E2E RF satellite-link emulation | SMW200A with K820 dynamic fading / channel emulation; FSW for component or SAN transmitter analysis | NTN E2E testing uses channel emulators for service and feeder links to emulate the RF satellite link between UE and NTN payload [8]. Measurable channel parameters include update interval, delay, Doppler and pathloss [8]. SMW200A supports customized dynamic fading, satellite trajectory modeling, atmospheric effects, longer path delays, enhanced Doppler, up to 1073 ms delay and up to ±1 MHz Doppler [8]. FSW is identified for component testing / SAN transmitter measurement and has up to 85 GHz frequency and 8 GHz analysis bandwidth in the cited summary [9][10][11]. | NTN configuration slides are recommended configurations, not formal configuration guide or quotation BOM [14]. |
### 限制
The FWA UE test requirement taxonomy is a solution overview and does not provide test cases, limits, configurations or pass/fail criteria [2]. The FWA roadmap source also states that it is not a formal test specification and lacks pass/fail limits, measurement uncertainty, test case IDs, calibration flow, fixtures, chamber details, DUT mode and software option dependencies [58]. The cited R&S tool labels support only that the tools are listed by the source; they do not prove a complete solution configuration [58].

[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

UL MIMO 4x4 Feature Study
本來源是 Rohde & Schwarz company restricted 的 [[UL MIMO 4x4]] feature study，分析 [[T-Mobile]] 為 Fixed Wireless Access device 類型要求 4-layer uplink MIMO 時，[[RRC]]、U-plane、[[MAC]]、[[PHY]]、[[RXMOD]]、[[RXFEC]]、測試與整合的影響。

UL MIMO 4x4 Feature Study › 與既有知識的關係
- 與 [[PUSCH]]：既有頁面整理 PUSCH 的 feature combination restrictions；本來源補充內部實作角度，說明 4-layer PUSCH 需要 MAC TPMI tables、PHY SW reporting、RXMOD stream mapping / equalization 與 RXFEC processing chain 調整。
- 與 [[PUSCH-Config]]：既有頁面只保存 frequency hopping offset list；本來源補充 PUSCH-Config already supported `maxRank INTEGER (1..4)` 與 out-of-scope `maxRank-v1810 INTEGER (5..8)`。
- 與 [[SRS]]：既有頁面描述 SRS 用途與 4 ports 相關待補；本來源確認 4 SRS antenna ports / `ports4` 在 RRC / RXMOD context 已支援，但不提供正式 3GPP clause。
- 與 [[Multiple SRS resources]]：既有頁面整理 codebook / nonCodebook / antennaSwitching usage 的 multiple SRS resources 限制；本來源沒有改寫該限制，只提供 UL MIMO 4x4 feature study 對 4 SRS antenna ports 的實作背景。
- 與 [[NR Stack]]：本來源屬於 NR stack feature feasibility / implementation study，但不是正式 3GPP standard 來源。

UL MIMO 4x4 Feature Study › 重點摘要
- 客戶需求來自 [[T-Mobile]]，目標主要是 Fixed Wireless Access device types 的 4-layer [[UL MIMO 4x4]]。[[UL MIMO 4x4 Feature Study]]
- Main requirements：maximum bandwidth 100 MHz、maximum sampling rate 122.88 MHz、subcarrier spacings 15 kHz / 30 kHz in [[NR FR1]]、maximum number of layers `N_L = 4`，並且 3 layers 也應支援。[[UL MIMO 4x4 Feature Study]]
- 來源要求每個 FPGA 的 maximum number of UL TRPs 為 1，並在 RQM 中明示不應允許在一個 FPGA 中配置 2 TRPs。[[UL MIMO 4x4 Feature Study]]
- [[RRC]] 被描述為 mostly transparent，因為 RRC already can configure up to 4 layers，且已支援 4 [[SRS]] antenna ports；但若 [[MAC]] / [[PHY]] 介面、reporting 或 consistency checks 改變，RRC 仍需調整。[[UL MIMO 4x4 Feature Study]]
- [[PUSCH-Config]] 中來源列出已支援的 `maxRank INTEGER (1..4)`、`transformPrecoder`、`txConfig`、`codebookSubset`、`resourceAllocation` 與 `dmrs-UplinkForPUSCH-MappingTypeA` 相關欄位；`maxRank-v1810 INTEGER (5..8)` 被列為 out of scope。[[UL MIMO 4x4 Feature Study]]
- [[SRS-Config]] 中來源列出 `nrofSRS-Ports ENUMERATED {port1, ports2, ports4}`，並將 `nrofSRS-Ports-n8-r18 ENUMERATED {ports8, ports8tdm}` 列為 out of scope。[[UL MIMO 4x4 Feature Study]]
- U-plane 被描述為 transparent，只預期 integration effort。[[UL MIMO 4x4 Feature Study]]
- [[MAC]] 需要更新 TPMI implementation，並實作 up to 4 layers 的 remaining tables；估計 effort 2–4 weeks。[[UL MIMO 4x4 Feature Study]]
- [[PHY SW]] 需要多個 interface extensions，包括 `PhyDataInd`、`MultiPhyDataInd` 的 EVM reporting / TdSlot information、`PhyRxSetupReq` 的 TPMI / CSI reporting rank、`CPhyPuschConfig` 的 MaxMIMOLayers、`CphyUlReport PuschInofrList EVM` 等；也需要 DMRS、PMI、UL power、SRS、FEC 與 MATLAB reference extensions。[[UL MIMO 4x4 Feature Study]]
- [[RXMOD]] 方面，4 antenna streams、1 / 2 PUSCH layers already possible；此 feature 要擴展到 3 / 4 [[PUSCH]] layers。SRS with 4 antenna ports already supported。[[UL MIMO 4x4 Feature Study]]

建議主軸：Use the market/use-case requirement to select the measurable RF/protocol/channel parameter, then require a Signal Generator for standard-compliant stimulus/channel emulation and a Signal Analyzer for frequency/bandwidth/EVM/spectrum analysis; for FWA, the source directly lists VSG/VSA, R&S SMW200A, R&S FSW, R&S CMP180/CMP200 among relevant instruments [1][54].
### 推薦先賣
知識庫未證實單一「最優先」產品；可直接對接的已證實方向是：FWA UE RF parametric / regulatory / coexistence testing uses indicators such as output power, EVM, OBW, receiver sensitivity BLER, emission mask, spurious emissions and WLAN coexistence, and the cited instrument examples include VSA, VSG, R&S FSW, R&S SMW200A and R&S CMP180/CMP200 [1][54]. NTN E2E testing directly maps to SMW200A channel emulation parameters such as delay, Doppler and pathloss, while FSW is identified for component testing / SAN transmitter measurement [8][9][10][11].
### 產品與 Option 對接表
| 產品線 | 可接軌的需求 | 知識庫確認的 option / 規格 | 為什麼適合 | 證據 | 缺口 / 報價風險 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S SMW200A Signal Generator / Channel Emulator | FWA RF parametric receiver stimulus; NTN E2E satellite RF link emulation | Frequency up to 67 GHz, RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz and up to 4 GHz with R&S SMW-K555; signal generation software includes LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18, OFDM and custom digital modulation [11]. For NTN E2E, SMW firmware ≥ 5.30 with K820 supports customized dynamic fading, satellite trajectory modeling, longer path delays, enhanced Doppler, up to 1073 ms delay and up to ±1 MHz Doppler [8]. | FWA test sources list VSG and R&S SMW200A as instruments, while NTN sources identify SMW200A as the core signal generator / channel emulator [1][9][10][54]. | [1][8][9][10][11][54] | FWA taxonomy does not provide test cases, limits, configurations or pass/fail criteria [2]. NTN recommended configurations are presentation recommendations, not a formal configuration guide or quotation BOM [14]. |
| R&S FSW Signal / Spectrum Analyzer | FWA RF parametric and regulatory TX analysis; NTN component testing / SAN transmitter measurement | Frequency up to 85 GHz with overrange to 90 GHz; analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz; signal analysis software includes LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18, OFDM signal analysis and vector signal analysis [11]. | FWA test sources list VSA and R&S FSW among instruments; NTN sources identify FSW for component testing and SAN transmitter measurement [1][9][10][11][54]. | [1][9][10][11][54] | Formal frequency/bandwidth/options should still be checked in formal product specifications, because the NTN source is a presentation summary [11][13]. |
| R&S CMP180 RF generator/analyzer communication tester | FWA production / wireless device multiport RF testing; WLAN coexistence-related Wi‑Fi signaling and NR FR1 measurements | CMP180 is a Radio Communication Tester configurable with multiport RF generator/analyzer, communication-standard measurement options, waveform options and R&S VSE analysis [16][17]. It supports simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing and RF generator/analyzer no. 1 plus optional no. 2, each with 8 SnapN ports [17][24]. IF bandwidth is 250 MHz, or 500 MHz with R&S CMP-K185 [21][27]. NR FR1 analyzer option R&S CMP-KM600 has EVM < 0.5% under the cited 100 MHz / SCS 30 kHz / 16QAM condition [22][28]. | FWA sources list CMP180/CMP200 among instruments, and FWA coexistence requires WLAN coexistence testing with Wi‑Fi signaling [1][54]. CMP180 has WLAN and NR measurement options listed in the knowledge base [22][23][28][29]. | [1][16][17][21][22][23][24][27][28][29][54] | CMP180 is a radio communication tester, not a standalone general-purpose VSG/VSA; the sources do not give a complete FWA configuration or quotation BOM [16][17][58]. |
| R&S CMX500 communication tester with vector signal analysis / ARB generator | FWA functional / signaling-style testing where E2E throughput, NSA/SA attach, latency and CA/ENDC/DC combinations are required | CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, RF parametric testing, fading propagation conditions and multiple OBT hardware configurations [47]. R&S CMX-B500A provides IF vector signal analysis and ARB generator functionality, and R&S CMX-B600B provides FR1 vector signal analysis and ARB generator functionality [41][42]. NR FR1 measurements support channel bandwidth 3 MHz to 100 MHz, and the CMX-KM600 analyzer EVM condition is <0.5% at 100 MHz under the cited condition; CMX-KW601 generator EVM is <0.5% at 100 MHz under the cited condition [43]. | FWA functional indicators include E2E max throughput, NSA/SA attach, latency and CA/ENDC/DC combinations, while the FWA roadmap source lists CMX500 among tool categories/instruments [54]. | [41][42][43][47][54] | This row is not pure “Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer”; it is a signaling/network-emulation tester with generator/analyzer functions [41][42][47]. |
### 場景切入建議
| 場景 | 推薦組合 | 切入重點 | 未驗證事項 |
|---|---|---|---|
| FWA UE RF parametric / operator-required RF TRX checks | SMW200A + FSW, or CMP180 where multiport production-style RF generator/analyzer is needed | Market/use-case side: FWA opportunities include DSL replacement, work/schooling from home, government broadband plans, connecting the unconnected and 5G launch [6]. Measurement side: RF parametric indicators include NR 3GPP RF TRx specification, output power, EVM, OBW, receiver sensitivity BLER, band permutations and CAs, and are mostly required by operators [1][54]. Capability side: SMW200A provides NR signal generation and wide frequency/modulation bandwidth, while FSW provides high-frequency, wideband NR signal analysis [11]. | Exact FWA test cases, limits, configurations and pass/fail criteria are not provided [2]. |
| FWA regulatory testing | FSW / signal-spectrum analysis path; SG only if the customer test setup requires a stimulus source | Regulatory indicators include RF output power, emission mask and spurious emissions, with the goal of CE/FCC certification [1][54]. FSW provides signal/spectrum analysis capability with frequency up to 85 GHz, overrange to 90 GHz and analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz [11]. | The passages do not provide country-specific regulatory test cases, limits or a full instrument configuration [2][58]. |
| FWA coexistence with Wi‑Fi | CMP180 RF generator/analyzer with WLAN measurement/generator options, plus broader VSG/VSA where needed | FWA coexistence testing is defined as WLAN coexistence testing with Wi‑Fi signaling to ensure no impact between different radios [1][54]. CMP180 supports communication-standard measurement options and RF generator/analyzer architecture [16][17], and its listed options include WLAN IEEE 802.11ax/be analyzer/generator capabilities [22][23][28][29]. | The knowledge base does not provide a full coexistence test plan, chamber/fixture setup, or pass/fail limits [58]. |
| NTN E2E RF satellite-link emulation | SMW200A with K820 dynamic fading / channel emulation; FSW for component or SAN transmitter analysis | NTN E2E testing uses channel emulators for service and feeder links to emulate the RF satellite link between UE and NTN payload [8]. Measurable channel parameters include update interval, delay, Doppler and pathloss [8]. SMW200A supports customized dynamic fading, satellite trajectory modeling, atmospheric effects, longer path delays, enhanced Doppler, up to 1073 ms delay and up to ±1 MHz Doppler [8]. FSW is identified for component testing / SAN transmitter measurement and has up to 85 GHz frequency and 8 GHz analysis bandwidth in the cited summary [9][10][11]. | NTN configuration slides are recommended configurations, not formal configuration guide or quotation BOM [14]. |
### 限制
The FWA UE test requirement taxonomy is a solution overview and does not provide test cases, limits, configurations or pass/fail criteria [2]. The FWA roadmap source also states that it is not a formal test specification and lacks pass/fail limits, measurement uncertainty, test case IDs, calibration flow, fixtures, chamber details, DUT mode and software option dependencies [58]. The cited R&S tool labels support only that the tools are listed by the source; they do not prove a complete solution configuration [58].

R&S CMX500 › NR FR1
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，R&S CMX-KM600 是 frequency range 1 對 NR uplink signals 執行任何 TX tests 的必要 option。NR FR1 uplink measurements 包含 multi-evaluation、PRACH、SRS、TPC measurement。Multi-evaluation 支援 NR channel bandwidth **3 MHz 到 100 MHz**，可分析 FDD 與 TDD signals、NR standalone signals 與 intraband contiguous EN-DC signals。

依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，R&S CMX-KM600 option 的 5G NR analyzer 條件為 FR1、SCS 30 kHz、16QAM、temperature range +15 °C to +35 °C；input level –25 dBm to –10 dBm RMS、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。Frequency measurement uncertainty：**< 20 Hz + drift of timebase**；相對於同一台 CMX500 device 的 downlink signal 進行 frequency error measurements 時，uncertainty 符合 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] V18.5.0。

R&S CMX-KW601 option 的 5G NR generator 條件：5G NR PDSCH、full allocation、SCS 30 kHz / 60 kHz、modulation 64QAM、PAR 11.8 dB、temperature +15 °C to +35 °C；ports RF Com 1、RF Com 2、RF Out 1 to RF Out 4；output level –5 dBm、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

5G FWA CPE EVT DVT PVT MP 測試路線圖 › 5G FWA UE test requirements
來源 slide 18 將 5G FWA UE test requirements and solutions 分成：

| Test type | Indicators | Goal |
|---|---|---|
| RF parametric | NR 3GPP RF TRx test specification、output power、EVM、OBW、receiver sensitivity level BLER、band permutations and CAs | Checks RF TRX performance；mostly required by operators |
| Functional | E2E max throughput DL/UL per band CA / ENDC / DC combos、24/7 long duration tests、NSA/SA attach、modulations <1024QAM、latency、SMS、USIM/eSIM authentication、FW versioning | Improve customer satisfaction；check battery life、thermal、firmware regression、module benchmark、heavy load behavior |
| Operator acceptance | Operator-specific test criteria | Verifies whether device meets operator criteria |
| Conformance | RF / RRM / PCT | [[GCF]] / [[PTCRB]] certification |
| OTA | [[CTIA]] OTA test specification | Verifies antenna performance，required by operators |
| Coexistence | WLAN coexistence testing with Wi-Fi signaling | Ensure no impact between different radios |
| Security | TCP/IP application message flows | SW vulnerability testing |
| Regulatory | RF output power、emission mask、spurious emissions | CE / FCC certification |

來源列出的 instruments / tool categories 包含 Power Supply、Power Meters、Scopes、VSA、VSG、Signaling、Conformance，以及 [[R&S RTO]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMP180]] / [[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S TS8980]]、[[R&S NGM200]]。
